استئما (form X)
# اُسْتُئِمَّا (ustuʔimmā) /us.tu.ʔim.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
# اِسْتَئِمَّا (istaʔimmā) /is.ta.ʔim.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
